content.text:
What kind of story is The Snow Queen?

The Snow Queen is Andersen's tale about a girl named Gerda who sets out on a long journey to rescue her friend Kai, who has been carried away by the cold Snow Queen. It's a winter classic about warm friendship and never-give-up courage.
content.caption: A journey to find a friend

content.alt: The Snow Queen - The original story of The Snow Queen
content.text:
The original story of The Snow Queen

A long fairy tale Andersen published in 1844, its heart lies in a mirror shard that turns the heart cold, the Snow Queen's ice palace, and Gerda's adventure. It's also known as an inspiration behind the film "Frozen."
content.caption: Cold magic
content.image_prompt: A cold elegant snow queen on an icy throne in a sparkling ice palace, beautiful winter children's book illustration, no text

content.alt: The Snow Queen - The Snow Queen plot summary
content.text:
The Snow Queen plot summary

A shard of magic mirror lodges in Kai's eye and heart, turning him cold, and he follows the Snow Queen away. Searching for her friend, Gerda passes through spring, summer, autumn, and winter, receiving help along the way until she reaches the ice palace. Gerda's warm tears and love melt Kai's heart, and the two friends return home together.
content.caption: Love that melted the ice

content.alt: The Snow Queen - The lessons of The Snow Queen
content.text:
The lessons of The Snow Queen

The core message is that true friendship and never-giving-up courage can melt even the coldest heart. Try asking your child, "Have you ever stayed by a friend's side even when they changed?"
content.caption: The spring that friendship made

content.alt: The Snow Queen - How to read it aloud to your child
content.text:
How to read it aloud to your child

Read the Snow Queen coldly and elegantly, and Gerda warmly and bravely. Since it's a long journey, it helps to mark the flow each time the season changes by asking, "What season is it now?" Suitable for ages 5-7.

content.text:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q. What age is The Snow Queen good for?
A. It's suitable for ages 5-7. Though it's a somewhat long journey, it's loved for its warm themes of friendship and courage.

Q. Is it the same as Frozen?
A. Frozen was inspired by The Snow Queen, but the plot is different. It's lovely to read the original tale alongside it.

Q. What kind of conversation is good to have?
A. Try talking together about "the heart that protects a friend to the end" and "the courage to never give up."
